description.value: Ginkgo Chinese Food is a locally rooted Chinese restaurant that has served the Sardis and Chilliwack area since 1999, earning a spot on the Chilliwack Progress A-List for five consecutive years. Located beside Staples on Vedder Road, it is one of two locations operated by the same family under the same brand. Touring cyclists passing through Sardis will find it a convenient casual stop for fresh Chinese food with online ordering available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating Chinese restaurant at 7579 Vedder Road, Sardis, matching OSM address and phone number. The site features an 'ORDER ONLINE' option and mentions orders accepted until 30 minutes before closing, confirming takeout service. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Tu-Su) does not fully match the hours listed on the website's Locations page for the Sardis location, which shows different Sunday hours and a different weekly schedule. Website should be considered authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant confirmed by active website and matching contact details. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists in the Sardis area.

Takeout.detail: Website prominently features an 'ORDER ONLINE' option and notes that orders are accepted until 30 minutes before closing
